name: CFC sells burn the pending amount from the pair before it arrives
summary: On every transfer into its pair, CFC took 95% of the amount out of the pair's existing balance and synced before crediting the transfer, so the attacker repeatedly sent CFC to the CFC/SAFE pair and skimmed it back, deflating the pair's CFC reserve, then sold into it for the pair's SAFE, 16.7 days after deployment.
notes: Loss is the pair's SAFE; its CFC is valued at nothing (rule 12).
